answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can be achieved through a proof-of-stake mechanism where each agent must lock a substantial amount of network tokens. This digital onyx serves as collateral, making each identity a costly island in the network. An attacker attempting to flood the system with fake identities faces a direct financial burden, proportional to the number of identities times the stake. This mechanism imposes a significant quartz-like economic cost, preventing easy exploitation by requiring tangible asset acquisition.
